[[File:Carny.png|250px|thumb|Carny]] '''Carny''' (Japanese: '''マスキさん''' ''Muski-san'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP082|Cream of the Croagunk Crop!]]''. Carny is the station chief in [[Pastoria City]]. He served as a judge of the {{p|Croagunk}} Festival held in the [[Great Marsh]], alongside [[Crasher Wake]] and [[Nurse Joy]]. He was most likely chosen as a judge because he has a keen eye for Croagunk and can tell the differences between each of the Croagunk participants. He showed a particular interest in [[Brock's Croagunk]] and {{MTR}}, who was disguised as a Croagunk. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{poison color}}|bordercolor={{fighting color light}} |ja=三宅健太 ''[[Kenta Miyake]]'' |en=[[Carter Cathcart|Billy Beach]] |fi=Pasi Ruohonen |fr_eu=Frédéric Clou |no=Erik Skøld |pl=Jacek Kałucki |pt_br=Ivo Roberto |es_eu=Abraham Aguilar}} ==Trivia== * Carny bears a resemblance to {{p|Carnivine}}, a Pokémon found in the [[Great Marsh]] of his own town. He is also named after this Pokémon in both English and Japanese.
